UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.title: Mandatory Transport Layer Encryption
UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.description: Government mail servers MUST enforce TLS encryption for all incoming and outgoing email protocol connections.

UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.title: Strong Cryptography for Open Transmissions
UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.description: Cardholder data MUST be encrypted during transmission across public and open networks using strong cryptography.

UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.title: Cleartext Email Transmission Considered Obsolete
UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.description: Cleartext transmission of email credentials and message content is explicitly designated as obsolete.

UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
UNENCRYPTED_EMAIL_TRAFFIC.description: Enforce TLS for all network data in transit across mail infrastructure interfaces.

DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.title: TLS Protocol Version Selection Standards
DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.description: TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 SHALL NOT be supported; servers MUST be configured for TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.title: Prohibition of Early TLS Protocols
DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.description: Early TLS (TLS 1.0 and SSL 3.0) is not strong cryptography and MUST be completely disabled.

DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.title: Minimum TLS Version Requirements
DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.description: Email submission and access implementations MUST support TLS 1.2 or higher.

DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.title: Disable Legacy & Deprecated Protocols
DEPRECATED_TLS_VERSION.description: Disable TLS 1.0, 1.1, and SSLv3 across all mail server configurations.

WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.title: Approved Cipher Suite Specifications
WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.description: Cipher suites utilizing 3DES, RC4, NULL, or EXPORT algorithms are strictly prohibited.

WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.title: Strong Encryption Algorithm Enforcement
WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.description: Ciphers with key length < 128 bits or known weak algorithms (RC4, 3DES) do not satisfy PCI compliance.

WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.title: Secure Cipher Suite Configuration
WEAK_CIPHER_SUITE.description: Disable weak stream and block ciphers across mail transfer agents.

NO_FORWARD_SECRECY.title: Ephemeral Key Exchange Preference
NO_FORWARD_SECRECY.description: TLS configurations SHOULD prefer cipher suites offering Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman (ECDHE or DHE).

NO_FORWARD_SECRECY.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy Preference
NO_FORWARD_SECRECY.description: Configure mail servers to prioritize Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) key exchanges.

EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.title: Certificate Lifetime and Validity
EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.description: Certificates MUST be valid at time of evaluation and renewed prior to expiration.

EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.title: Valid Trust Certificates
EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.description: Keys and certificates used for transmission encryption MUST be valid and unexpired.

EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.title: Manage Certificate Lifecycles
EXPIRED_CERTIFICATE.description: Ensure automated renewal of X.509 certificates prior to expiration date.

WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.title: Minimum Public Key Size Standards
WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.description: RSA keys MUST be at least 2048 bits in length.

WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.title: Minimum Asymmetric Key Size
WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.description: RSA public keys used for server authentication must be 2048 bits or greater.

WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.title: Strong Key Length Enforcement
WEAK_CERT_RSA_KEY.description: Enforce minimum 2048-bit RSA keys for server certificates.

SHA1_CERT_SIGNATURE.title: Approved Signature Digest Algorithms
SHA1_CERT_SIGNATURE.description: Certificates signed with SHA-1 digest algorithms SHALL NOT be accepted.

SHA1_CERT_SIGNATURE.title: Deprecated Hash Algorithms
SHA1_CERT_SIGNATURE.description: SHA-1 signatures are deprecated and do not meet strong cryptography criteria.

SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.title: Trusted Certificate Authority Chains
SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.description: Certificates MUST be issued by an approved or trusted Certificate Authority.

SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.title: Trusted CA Certificates
SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.description: Certificates used for public transmissions must be issued by a recognized CA.

SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.title: CA Trust Validation
SELF_SIGNED_CERTIFICATE.description: Untrusted self-signed certificates should not be used in production.

JA3_KNOWN_MALICIOUS_FINGERPRINT.title: Network Threat & Beacon Detection
JA3_KNOWN_MALICIOUS_FINGERPRINT.description: Detect and flag known malicious TLS fingerprints and C2 beacons.
